offer.heading: Credential Offer
offer.disclaimer: Credential offer generated from the catalog. Without an encrypted issuer_state it only enables a request for a credential type after authentication (if eligible). The form below is an example: it does not use the PDND GetAttributeClaims key.
offer.urnMissing: URN cannot be built: authentic source entity_id or dataset_id is missing.
offer.objectIdHint: Identifier of the instance at the Authentic Source. If empty, the URN omits the objectId segment.
offer.publicKeyHint: RSA-OAEP-256 / A256GCM. If set, the URN is encrypted and placed in grants.authorization_code.issuer_state.
offer.encryptError: Could not encrypt the URN with the given key.
